texto: The world resets every night at 3:07. So on day three, you memorize the lottery numbers.
You buy the ticket. You win twenty-three million dollars.
You eat at the fanciest restaurant in town and walk out without paying. You tell your boss exactly what you think of him.
Then 3:07 hits, and it's all gone.
And somewhere around the fifth sunset, you realize that if nothing sticks, nothing matters.
Then someone in line says one word that isn't supposed to be there.
